prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected measurements, except for Round 6 where the prediction was too low.
finish new_screen changes are effective (+3.6% average after noise correction across 2 tests, with 1 winning test).
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_screen changes (only 1 test, which performed worse at -5.2% after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for finish redesign changes (only 1 test, which performed worse at -6.9% after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for sign_in reorder changes (only 1 test, which showed no clear effect at -0.5% after noise correction).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -5.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +3.6% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -6.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -0.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 76.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.9%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Finish Setup Desktop Interactions Guide Screen: Adds a new guidance screen right before finishing onboarding that visualizes basic desktop pet gestures, system tray controls, and hotkeys. (why: Support mails show users are confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.)
1: [home, new_screen] Waiting Step Desktop Spawning Progress Screen: Adds an animated companion spawning screen during the home waiting step with real-time initialization steps. (why: Home waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, and support reports pets not displaying on desktop.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Pet Account Warning Hint: Displays a clear hint on the sign-in screen reminding users to log in with their original account to preserve existing pets. (why: 8 emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again with a secondary or fresh account.)
3: [adoption, wait_info] Adoption Certificate Final Verification Info: Adds a progress indicator and live status updates on the adoption certificate screen while pet assets generate. (why: Adoption step has the biggest dropoff (60.9% conversion, median 89s), indicating user hesitation while awaiting confirmation.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Spawn Ready Desktop Notification: Enables readiness notifications and delay tips on the waiting screen when the pet is ready to spawn on desktop. (why: Home step has a very long mean time (2336s) and users complain pets fail to appear on desktop.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Story Screen Path Clarity Headline Copy: Updates headline and body on the initial story screen to clearly set expectations for the desktop companion setup. (why: Story and choose path step have an 8-minute mean time (514s), suggesting users start without clear direction.)
6: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Compact Companion Layout: Changes the layout of the pick friend screen to a compact view with instant visual companion previews. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%). Streamlining pet selection helps users pick faster.)

scores.note: Targeted support issues match finish screen; finish new_screen historical performance is positive (+3.6%).
Home step suffers from extreme mean delay (2336s) and user complaints, though adding a new screen carries release overhead.
Simple hint configuration addressing 8 specific email complaints regarding account resets.
Adoption is the biggest funnel bottleneck (60.9% conversion); status updates reduce drop-off during asset generation.
Directly targets high mean latency on home step by notifying users when spawn finishes.
Low cost copy tweak addressing long mean duration at initial onboarding step.
Targets lowest converting step, but layout/redesign changes on adoption previously underperformed.
